features.name: Basic Shapes
steps: Insert a rectangle, ellipse, and diamond
Place them at different positions on the page
Verify text remains attached to its corresponding shape
features.expected: Rectangle, ellipse, and diamond must be placed at distinct positions; text must remain attached to its shape after moving and resizing.

features.name: Shape Style
steps: Change fill color, stroke color, stroke width, line style, opacity, rounded corners, and shadow
Select another shape and apply a different style
Verify styles remain associated with the correct objects after deselection
features.expected: Each style property must apply to the selected shape only; styles stay associated with the correct objects after deselection.

features.name: Connector
steps: Create a connector from the first shape to the second using connection points
Move both shapes to new positions
Connector endpoints remain attached and routing updates automatically
Change arrowhead and line style without breaking the connection
features.expected: Connector endpoints must remain attached after moving both shapes and routing updates automatically; arrowhead and line style changes do not break the connection.

features.name: Flowchart
steps: Create Start, Process, Decision, and End nodes
Connect them into a directed process
Create Yes / No branches from the decision node
Rearrange nodes while preserving the intended graph topology
features.expected: Flowchart nodes must connect into the intended directed graph; Yes/No branches from the decision node work; topology survives rearrangement.

features.name: Multi-step Flowchart Editing
steps: Insert a new process node into an existing path
features.expected: New node must be inserted into the path with predecessor to new node to successor reconnected; routing and labels adjust; the final graph is logically correct.

features.name: Arrow Styles
steps: Change straight / orthogonal / curved routing where available
Preserve selected connector styling and endpoint relationships
features.expected: Arrow type, routing, color, and thickness changes must persist on the selected connectors; endpoint relationships hold after moving nodes.

features.name: Shape Libraries
steps: Expand Basic, Arrows, Flowchart, Entity Relation, and UML libraries
Locate specified symbols from different libraries
Arrange them without replacing previously created objects
features.expected: Specified symbols from different libraries must be draggable to the canvas; arranging them does not replace previously created objects.

features.name: Entity Relationship Diagram
steps: Arrange the diagram so relationships remain readable
Modify one entity without damaging other relationships
features.expected: Entity objects must be created, labeled, and connected with relationship connectors; editing one entity does not damage other relationships.

features.name: UML Diagram
steps: Insert two or more class-style objects
features.expected: Class-style objects must be inserted with names/attributes; relationships keep direction and layout after repositioning.

features.name: Alignment / Distribution
steps: Create five shapes at irregular positions
Align them to a common edge
Preserve their relative order and individual labels
features.expected: Selected shapes must align to a common edge and distribute evenly; relative order and individual labels are preserved.

features.name: Layer Order
steps: Move one object to front / back
Verify the final visible stacking order matches the requested order
features.expected: Final stacking order must match the requested order after send backward / bring forward / to front / to back operations.

features.name: Group / Ungroup
steps: Edit an individual child object without changing the other copy
features.expected: Grouped unit must move and resize together; copied group is independent; editing one copy's child does not change the other.

features.name: Arrange Complex Layout
steps: Apply an automatic layout such as vertical flow, horizontal flow, tree, or organic layout
Connections remain valid after the layout operation
features.expected: Automatic layout must reorganize the diagram; one manually corrected node stays valid; connections remain valid after layout.

features.name: Tree Layout
steps: Create a root node with multiple child nodes and grandchildren
Apply vertical or horizontal tree layout
Add another child and rerun the layout
features.expected: Tree layout must retain parent-child structure; adding a child and re-running layout keeps the tree readable.

features.name: Organization Chart
steps: Create a manager node, several direct reports, and lower-level reports
Preserve the hierarchical connections and labels
features.expected: Hierarchy must be connected and laid out; manually moving one branch preserves hierarchical connections and labels.

features.name: Complex Diagram Reconstruction
steps: Reproduce a reference diagram containing multiple shape types, text labels, connectors, colors, and hierarchical relationships
Final diagram preserves both visual structure and graph semantics
features.expected: Final diagram must preserve both visual structure and graph semantics; wrong connections or stacking are corrected.

features.name: Multi-select Editing
steps: Create several shapes with different styles
Select a subset using box selection or multi-select
Verify unselected objects were not modified
features.expected: Shared property changes must apply only to selected shapes; unselected objects remain unmodified.

features.name: Copy / Duplicate / Delete
steps: Move duplicated objects to another location
Ensure copied objects remain independent from originals
features.expected: Duplicated objects must be independent; deleting an original and repairing affected connectors leaves copies intact.

features.name: Freehand Drawing
steps: Change brush width / color where available
Select, move, or delete a resulting drawing object
Continue editing the rest of the diagram normally
features.expected: Freehand strokes must be created as drawing objects; selecting, moving, or deleting one works; the rest of the diagram remains editable.

features.name: Page Setup
steps: Change grid size and page background
Existing objects remain present and correctly positioned relative to the page
features.expected: Page settings (size, orientation, grid, background) must apply; existing objects remain present and correctly positioned.

features.name: Grid / Guides / Connection Helpers
steps: Toggle grid, guides, connection arrows, and connection points
Create and move shapes while these helpers are enabled
Helper visibility changes without altering actual diagram data
features.expected: Helper toggles must change visibility only; diagram data remains unaltered.

features.name: Zoom / View State
steps: Create objects across different regions of a page
Zoom in and pan to a specific area
Diagram data remains stable across viewport changes
features.expected: Zooming and panning must not modify diagram data; edits apply to the correct objects across viewport changes.

features.name: Multi-page Diagram
steps: Create different objects on the second page
Each page preserves its own objects and viewport-independent content
features.expected: Each page must preserve its own objects; switching between pages repeatedly keeps content intact.

features.name: Page Lifecycle
steps: Verify only the targeted page was deleted and duplicated content remains editable
features.expected: Duplicating and deleting pages must affect only the targeted page; duplicated content remains editable.

features.name: Local Save / Reopen
steps: Create a non-trivial diagram with shapes, text, and connectors
Save the editable diagram file locally
Close or reset the current diagram
Verify objects, connections, pages, labels, and styles are restored and remain editable
features.expected: Reopened file must restore objects, connections, pages, labels, and styles; everything remains editable.

features.name: Export PNG / SVG
steps: Configure basic export options where available
features.expected: PNG/SVG export must produce the expected output; the original editable diagram remains unchanged.

features.name: Multi-page PDF Export
steps: Export the complete document as PDF
Preserve page ordering and page boundaries
Return to the editor without losing editable diagram state
features.expected: PDF export must preserve page ordering and boundaries; editor state is not lost.

features.name: Search / Find
steps: Create a diagram containing repeated and unique text labels
Verify the intended object was modified without changing unrelated labels
features.expected: Find/Replace must navigate to and modify only the intended object; unrelated labels stay unchanged.

features.name: Reference Diagram Revision
steps: Preserve all unaffected parts of the original diagram
features.expected: Two new nodes added, obsolete node removed, dependencies reconnected, alignment corrected; all unaffected parts preserved.

features.name: End-to-end Architecture Diagram
steps: Add application, database, process, and external-system style nodes from multiple libraries
Add a second page for a detailed sub-flow
Save and reopen the editable file
features.expected: Multi-library nodes, labeled connectors, grouping, consistent styles, alignment, second page, save/reopen must all complete correctly.

exclusions.feature:
Real-time Collaboration / Share
Invite other users → Simultaneous multi-user editing → Presence, cursor synchronization, comments, or remote conflict handling
exclusions.reason: 依赖多人账号、实时网络同步和远端协作基础设施；主要测的是协作后端而非单 Agent 的图形编辑能力，因此预先排除

exclusions.feature:
Google Drive / OneDrive / Dropbox / GitHub Storage
Open from or save directly into third-party cloud storage → Synchronize changes with an external provider
exclusions.reason: 依赖第三方 OAuth、账户权限和外部存储 API。Benchmark 可用本地保存 / 打开替代，从而仍然覆盖文件持久化

exclusions.feature:
Publish / Public Link / Embed
Publish a diagram → Generate public URL → Embed into another site
exclusions.reason: 依赖托管、网络访问和公开权限管理，不属于图形编辑器本身的核心交互

exclusions.feature:
External Plugins
Install or configure plugins → Run third-party plugin commands
exclusions.reason: 插件环境、版本和外部代码不可控，复现结果不稳定；对应能力应由原生图形、布局、编辑 Task 覆盖

exclusions.feature:
External Shape Libraries Requiring Network
Load remote vendor libraries or externally hosted custom stencil packs
exclusions.reason: 外部资源可能变化或不可访问；Benchmark 只使用应用内置且可稳定获得的 Basic / Flowchart / UML / ER 等图形库

exclusions.feature:
AI / Generated Diagram Features
Generate diagrams or content from prompts where third-party or AI services are involved
exclusions.reason: 需要独立模型或远端推理组件，测到的是生成模型能力而不是 Agent 对 diagrams.net UI 和图结构的操作能力

exclusions.feature:
Account / Subscription / Team Administration
Login, billing, workspace, organization, team, license, or account settings
exclusions.reason: 与绘图任务本身无直接关系，同时依赖账户状态；不适合作为复现 diagrams.net 核心能力的 benchmark

exclusions.feature:
Email / Notification / Social Functions
Send invitations, notifications, email links, social sharing
exclusions.reason: 属于外围通信能力，不考察图形编辑、关系构建、布局和持久化

exclusions.feature:
Print to Physical Printer
Configure printer driver → Select physical printer → Complete OS-level print workflow
exclusions.reason: 强依赖操作系统、硬件和打印驱动；使用 PDF 导出即可覆盖页面设置和输出能力

exclusions.feature:
Browser / OS File-dialog Specific Behavior
Require exact native file picker layout, download shelf behavior, or OS-specific save dialog navigation
exclusions.reason: 这些界面由浏览器和操作系统控制，不属于目标网站实现；只验证“最终文件成功保存 / 打开 / 导出”

exclusions.feature:
Full Format Compatibility Matrix
Import and perfectly reproduce every Visio, Lucidchart, Gliffy, SVG, XML, or proprietary format
exclusions.reason: 涉及大量第三方格式兼容边界，容易把 benchmark 变成转换器测试；仅保留必要的本地 editable file 与 PNG / SVG / PDF 输出

exclusions.feature:
Embedded Web Content / External URLs
Embed live webpages or depend on external URLs rendering inside the diagram
exclusions.reason: 依赖目标站点的网络状态、安全策略和跨域行为；普通超链接或文本对象可由基础编辑 Task 覆盖

exclusions.feature:
Presentation / Remote Slideshow Integrations
Publish and remotely present diagrams to other participants
exclusions.reason: 更接近协作和分发系统，不是核心绘图能力；页面、缩放和视图状态已有独立 Task 覆盖

exclusions.feature:
Exact Theme / Language / Cosmetic Preference Replication
Switch every theme, locale, menu preference, or purely cosmetic UI setting
exclusions.reason: 可保留浅色/深色等基本可用性测试，但不应作为主 benchmark；核心评分应放在对象、关系、布局、页面和文件状态上
